screening.scope: All selected frames and all8 cameras compared with shared animated LHM scene. Native RGB area-downsampled with exact pixel-center K. Eroded candidate person mask, union of observed and rendered helmet dilated3pixels excluded, initial decoded/accumulated alpha>.8. Fixed initial support and decoder alpha are cached for subsequent fitting and support accounting. Per-observation128pixel eligibility is minimum support only; no claim of segmentation accuracy, cross-camera consistency, dynamic selection, all-data feature fitting or novel-view quality. Appearance, shape and motion are unchanged. No camera gain fitted here; sRGB residual includes exposure, geometry, pose and segmentation errors. Private RGB/camera cache must not be published. Additional local selection: native COCO17 surface-joint residual below4% observed torso length (4px floor), RTMW score>2/in-image/positive depth; torso polygon and limb capsules only when corresponding observed joints agree.9pixel eroded silhouette and any-channel>=250 clipping excluded. Head/hands are not feature-training targets in this conservative body pass. Selection uses geometry/detector evidence, not low photometric error; it is not a cross-view surface-correspondence verification. High-resolution portrait-crop comparison:504x756, fixed per-camera all-time person-mask envelope plus explicit padding/aspect fit, exact pixel-center K. Source RGB uses area box resampling, masks nearest; source beyond native canvas is masked-out padding. No model-derived crop or per-frame crop motion.

feature_fit.scope: One canonical feature tensor receives gradients from all eligible selected times and training cameras. Fixed initial support prevents mask shrinking from removing RGB loss; initial decoder mask anchored. Fixed per-camera channel gains calibrated on initial model; heldout gain1. Bounded feature delta±0.05, static geometry/poses/decoder, no geometry or beta refinement. Camera holdout is only conditional feature-overfit diagnostic because initializer and earlier motion used all8. Training error and support are not independent novel-view quality; must rerender before adoption. No dynamic cross-view reliability selection yet. Private tensors/images remain local. NEW response: linear-light RGB; fixed reference camera gain1; other gains from temporal medians of same-view model-to-image log ratios, scalar exposure plus log-white-balance±.1; clipped-white target pixels excluded with static support. Loss compares corrected real RGB in reference units, so this metric is not comparable with old sRGB loss. This fixes brightness gauge but still inherits initial geometry/appearance bias; correspondence-graph calibration was rejected and is NOT used.

integrated_loop.scope: One shared body feature update from locally alignment-screened nonclipped body pixels across all8x300 observations. Shape/rig/geometry/motion/decoder and head/hand-dominant feature rows fixed; feature bound.05.20phase times used for response calibration and loss audit, independently replayed all8+2 for actual visual comparison. Source-bearing sheets and all tensors remain private. Not geometry refinement or full300 new video; quality adoption requires visual review.

storyboard.scope: Matched-camera whole-candidate review. Each of20 original keyframes held1second for inspection, explicitly NOT continuous action video. Original RGB panels only in *_private.jpg; generated-only pages/videos may be published. Model-projected head crops use SAME rectangle for source/before/after. Camera matrices/raw source pixels are not in the public report.

saved_contract.scope: Independent saved-scene loading and fixed-tensor comparison. Confirms the actual candidate changes only allowed body feature rows, all300 motion/rig/decoder/helmet/cameras unchanged. Does not claim visual improvement.

scope: Scalar records and pure generated review only. Shared body features updated using selected body pixels from all8x300; all geometry/motion/decoder and head/hand feature rows fixed. Quality decision is recorded in ALIGNED_BODY_FEATURE_STAGE.md, not inferred from training loss.
